title: Transfer: Data Center Campus Feeder Rebalance
goal: Compare two campus power-distribution scenarios for a large data center portfolio with different hall-level load placements, and produce a report on feeder flows, overloaded ties, bus-angle changes, and the feeders that gain the most relief after rebalancing.
skillBenefitRationale: The task moves dc-power-flow into behind-the-meter infrastructure operations while preserving the same essential skill: solve linear power balance with a slack reference and derive feeder flow/loading changes from altered nodal injections.
